description_for_human: Analyze and diagnose Power BI Desktop files open on your PC.
description_for_model: Analysis of Power BI Desktop (.pbix) files, plus approved, reversible edits to COPIES of Power BI files (.pbix .pbit .pbip .pbir .pbids .rdl .tmdl) in a dedicated edit folder, on the user's PC: the data model (tables, columns, DAX measures, relationships, row-level security, hierarchies, size), Power Query (M code, refresh errors, query folding, SQL Server / SharePoint / OneDrive connections), the report layout (pages, visuals, filters, hidden pages), data-quality probes and dashboard comparison. Use it whenever the user asks to analyze, audit, diagnose, review or compare a Power BI file, asks why a refresh fails or data is missing or slow, what a dashboard connects to, or who can see what data. Always call find_dashboards first, then audit_dashboard for a full review.
